lookup: programmeSummary(profile.candidacyId, question.id); null preserves the original specific rationale.
reviewMethod: Read the existing rationale, every exact quote, and the complete stored context for each derived mapping, formation by formation. Whitespace was normalized only in terminal reading output; bank content was never edited.

Write each fixed Spanish summary directly, preserving the scope, temporal qualifiers, negations, exceptions and quantities that qualify the compared proposal. Original rationale and original citations remain available.
Do not shorten unknown/conflicting positions into a misleading generic political claim. Their existing specific rationale remains the display text.
Run a deterministic bank SHA and identifier/coverage check after authorship. This checks parity, not semantic truth or actual screen usability.
explicitQualificationChecks: PP nuclear extension retains Nuclear Safety Council consent and European rules; PSOE dental care retains the gradual extension starting over age 75.
Mortgage guarantees retain PP up-to-35/up-to-95%; PSOE under-35/20%/first habitual home; Junts up-to-35/first home/initial mortgage payment.
Sumar 37.5 hours in 2024 followed by negotiation toward 32 hours; flight substitution retains safe appropriate train connections under four hours.
BNG electricity-only cut prohibition and Galicia inflation scope remain visible; Junts container return retains evaluation and feasibility testing.
VOX public-housing ownership exception for temporarily assigned SAREB assets and savings-only inflation adjustment remain visible.
FE de las JONS dental eligibility restricted to Spanish people remains visible; its existing nuclear extension and new construction are not conflated.
Every boe-2023-059 summary retains the 2023 draft status. Its qualified nuclear and surrogacy conditions remain in the first layer.
A copied sentence that already uses plain language may remain close to its original wording. Brevity never takes priority over a qualifier.
limitations: This stage reviews the already accepted bank and its stored citation contexts. It is not new source acquisition or a fresh complete-programme reading campaign.
The unchanged bank may contain limitations described in its original interpretation or source record; this presentation layer does not silently revise them.

No automated check establishes semantic correctness, and this ledger alone does not establish visual usability. Screen-level copy, keyboard and comprehension evidence belongs to the integrated application review.

limitations: The original 80 bank questions/help, programme names, citation/source texts and data-contract export fields are preserved rather than reauthored.
